req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that POST /players/ must accept payloads without a nickname field, treating nickname as optional. Examining the source, PlayerRequestModel has no 'nickname' field at all — the optional fields are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, and starting11. The requirement's intent maps to: a minimal payload (only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position) must succeed with HTTP 201. We test: (1) positive EP — payload with all required fields and no optional fields returns 201 and correct body; (2) positive EP — payload explicitly omitting every optional field still returns 201; (3) negative NEG — payload missing a truly required field (first_name) returns 422; (4) boundary BVA — payload with squad_number at boundary value (0) to probe numeric edge; (5) DT — payload with some optional fields present and some absent returns 201, verifying partial optional inclusion. All tests use squad numbers not in the pre-loaded fixture (27+) to avoid 409 conflicts, and assert exact status codes and response body fields.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded fixture rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number=27, position
Omit all optional fields: middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Test', lastName='Player', squadNumber=27, position='Forward'
Optional fields in response are null/None
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without optional fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Forward"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201()

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_required_first_name_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 28,
        "position": "Midfielder"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    errors = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(errors, list)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    field_names = [e["loc"][-1] for e in errors if "loc" in e]
    assert "first_name" in field_names or "firstName" in field_names

test_post_player_missing_required_first_name_returns_422()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_set_on_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 31 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields and squad_number=31
expected: Response body id is a valid UUID string
trace: R-PLAYER-040: successful POST returns 201 with Location header; EP on required-only payload
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_set_on_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Header",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 31,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in r.headers or "Location" in r.headers
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/31"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 31
    parsed_id = uuid.UUID(body["id"])
    assert str(parsed_id) == body["id"]

test_post_player_location_header_set_on_201()
